# Generated Astra Documentation

This directory is the output target for the Astra automated documentation engine in `tools/astra-docs/`.

## Expected generated files

- `inventory.json` — raw structured discovery
- `sanitized-inventory.json` — redacted structured discovery
- `astra-runbook.md` — generated operational snapshot

Generated files can contain environment-specific information. Review them before committing to the public repository.

The directory README is tracked so the output location exists before the first live scan.
